title: list_tracks result
description: What list_tracks returns: the per-track state the project context snapshot deliberately leaves out. The snapshot carries only guid, name, and role per track, so volume, pan, mute, solo, record arm, colour, learned aliases, and item count are read here when a prompt needs them. A read tool, so no undo report. Volume is in decibels and pan is a percentage — the units set_track_state accepts, so a level read here can be written straight back.

tracks.description: The tracks the call asked about, in REAPER's track order. The whole project when the call supplied no selectors, otherwise only the tracks named, in the order they were named.

trackState.description: One track's state. The index is reported so the agent can say "track 7" to a producer looking at REAPER's track numbers, and must not be used to address the track on a follow-up call — an index read here may name a different track by the time that call lands.

index.description: Zero-based position in the project's track order.

name.description: Track name as shown in REAPER.

aliases.description: Every alias the producer has taught for this track, in the order they were learned. Absent or empty when none have been. Read as of the last project save — an alias taught in an unsaved session is not here yet. This is the only read path for learned vocabulary in the protocol, so a track answering to several names reports all of them here.

soloed.description: Whether the track is soloed. Worth reading before a render: a soloed track changes what a master mix contains.

armed.description: Whether the track is armed for recording.

itemCount.description: Number of media items on the track. A count rather than the items, which are read with list_selected_items.

fxChain.description: Names of the FX on the track's chain, in chain order. Present when the call asked for the chain, which it does by default. Names only — bypass state and chain index come from list_track_fx, and parameters from get_fx_parameters.

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

structuralRole.description: What the track does in the session's signal flow, derived by the extension from folder depth, parent send state, item count, FX presence, and receive count. The same enumeration project-context.schema.json reports.

volumeDecibels.description: Fader level in decibels, where 0 is unity. Same range the input definitions accept, so a level read back can be written back.

panPercent.description: Pan position as a percentage, where -100 is hard left, 0 is centre, and 100 is hard right.

color.description: Colour as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB string prefixed with #.
